scores.evidence: Both objectives are can-do statements with Bloom verbs (設計できる, 判断できる). o1 is assessed by q1, q2, e1 and e2, and o2 by q3, q4 and e3, with apply/evaluate items in each set. The off-objective e4 is gone. The create-level o1 is performed in practice-setup, and the scored items for it are selected-response.

hook-b1 is a concrete 3-sentence scenario (「初日にスキル（skill）5つとフック（hook）3つを一度に入れようとして、手が止まりました」) and is followed by the ungraded pq0. pq0's explanation now states the day-1 exception (「ただし、秘密情報とpushの守りは例外で、初日から置きます」), so the rule no longer contradicts the example.

dr-table still ties each part to the lesson that taught it, and the caption now says what the parentheses mean (「かっこ内は学んだ回。公式ドキュメントの対応表から」). The header 「繰り返す困りごと」 matches the glossary meaning of きっかけ, which dr-b1 defines just before the table. This change removed the English from the first body use of サブエージェント: the cell went from 「[[サブエージェント]]（subagent、第7回）」 to 「[[サブエージェント]]（第7回）」, and no other body block in the lesson glosses it. The contract requires the English on first use, and the lesson does this for スキル（skill）, フック（hook）, プラグイン（plugin） and 権限ルール（permission rule）. The term is still linked to the glossary, whose definition says 「英語ではsubagent」, so this scores 3, not 2.

Re-measured after the dr-table change. measure.mjs: 「prose 1329 (budget 1,200–2,400) · read 1820 · practice reading 1657 · questions 8 · practice sections 3 · est 19.1 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」. estMinutes 19 matches the rounded estimate. The table cells are shorter now (「CLAUDE.mdに1行（第6回）」), and lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings.

ex-hook now explains the artefact instead of only naming it (「`jq` で編集したファイル名を取り出し、Prettierに渡します。」), and ex-settings highlights the right lines in the reformatted JSON: 3 (ask), 5 and 6 (deny entries), 12 (matcher) and 16 (command). All 5 steps still have subgoal titles, a trigger and an expect, and they come before practice. There is still no faded step between the full example and independent practice.

4 of the 5 content sections end in an inline check (q1–q4), never 2 in a row without one. The checks are apply/evaluate items set in new situations, with feedback on every wrong option. q4's stem now describes a symptom (「Claudeが、前の作業の前提を混ぜ始めました」) rather than naming the checklist item.

All 7 misconceptions in the brief map to distractors. Each feedback is 2 sentences or fewer and gives a reason (q2 b 「拒否すると、package.jsonを変えたときにも入れられなくなります」; q3 d about reviewers asked to find faults). dr-b2 now gives both the day-1 exception and the limit of the rules (「`git -C . push` のような別の書き方のpushは、止まりません」).

dr-table is still a real 2-column comparison table, with 5 rows that pair a repeated problem with a part. The shorter header (「足す部品」) and the caption note make it narrower without losing information. cycle-flow is unchanged: 5 nodes plus the review loop, with caption and alt. There are no decorative images.

sc-safety now checks something the learner can verify by looking at the file (「安全：秘密情報の拒否ルールと、git pushの確認ルールを書きました」). Before, it promised a result (「pushの前に確認が入ります」). Every step has an expect, the model answers come after the hints, and self-check-list is the success checklist. c-review and c-commit still have no hint or troubleshoot, so the hint ladder is incomplete.

The summary still comes after the exam and has 4 points. Point 2 now reads 「Claudeの判断に任せたくないことは、権限ルールとフックに置きます。」, the same wording as dr-b2 and the e1 feedback (「Claudeの判断に任せず止める権限ルール」). The reflection prompt, the next step, 7 flashcards and 3 askTutor suggestions are unchanged.

Both remaining overstatements from the last round are fixed. ex-claude-md's expect now reads 「起動し直すと、`/context` の「Memory files」に出ます。」, which matches cc-prompt-caching (「The new content loads on the next /clear, /compact, or restart」) and p-restart. sc-safety no longer promises a push prompt. ex-rules now limits the auto-mode default to the right sessions (「ターミナルとVS Codeの対話セッションはautoモードで始まります」), as cross-lesson-facts item 1 says (「for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions only」). The ex-hook command matches the hooks-guide example in facts-cc-11-capstone.md character for character.
The changed text keeps です・ます and a calm tone (「そのため、`git push` は確認ルール（ask）にします。」; 「Claudeの判断に任せたくないことは」). 確認ルール, 拒否ルール and きっかけ still match the glossary, and lint finds no banned phrase.

dr-table's caption and column headers are plain text without markdown (「きっかけと、足す部品（かっこ内は学んだ回。公式ドキュメントの対応表から）」), which suits fields that render without markdown. The table keeps 2 real header cells for screen readers. cycle-flow's alt text is complete, and the jp locale is complete.

mustFix.issue: Regression from this round's dr-table change. The row-3 cell went from 「[[サブエージェント]]（subagent、第7回）」 to 「[[サブエージェント]]（第7回）」. dr-table is the first body use of サブエージェント, and no other body block glosses it, so the lesson no longer gives the English on first use. That breaks lesson-contract §6 (「Katakana terms carry the English on first use」), and the lesson does give it for スキル（skill）, フック（hook）, プラグイン（plugin） and 権限ルール（permission rule）.
mustFix.fix: In dr-table row 3, column 2, replace 「[[サブエージェント]]（第7回）」 with 「[[サブエージェント]]（subagent、第7回）」.

niceToHave: dr-table row 1 dropped its verb (「CLAUDE.mdに1行（第6回）」), while the next rows name whole parts. For a clear action, change it to 「CLAUDE.mdに1行足す（第6回）」.
c-review (cycle-steps) has no hint or troubleshoot. Add hint 「指摘が多すぎたら、計画の要件に関わるものだけに絞ってと頼みます。」
c-commit (cycle-steps) has no hint. Add hint 「1行目が長すぎたら、「何を変えたかを1行目に50字以内で」と頼みます。」
p-claude-md's 「25行以内」 is unexplained, while e3 a's feedback calls 40 lines fine under the official 200-line guide. Change p-claude-md's hint to 「最初は25行以内を目安にします。各行に「消したらまちがえる？」と聞きます。」
sc-b1 calls an unmet checklist item a きっかけ, but the glossary defines きっかけ as 「同じ困りごとが繰り返し起きること」. Change 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すもののきっかけです。」 to 「当てはまらない項目が、次に足すものの候補です。」

worked (to reach 4): add a faded step before practice-setup. For example, add a q-style prompt where the learner picks the part for ③ before seeing it, or leave one ex-steps item's md for the learner to complete.
summary: Verification round. review-scope exited 0: 1 of 31 blocks changed (2%), with no change to sections or objectives. The previous round had no open must-fix items, so there are no resolved entries. I reviewed the changed block, dr-table, in full. Its headers are shorter, and the note that the parentheses give the lesson number moved into the caption, so the table is narrower for mobile. The change also dropped the English gloss from the first body use of サブエージェント (「（subagent、第7回）」 became 「（第7回）」). That is a lesson-contract regression and is the one must-fix. I re-scored prior (now 3), load, visual and a11y_l10n, and carried the other 9 criteria over. validate and lint --strict are clean. measure.mjs gives prose 1,329 and est 19.1 min against estMinutes 19. Every criterion is 3 or higher and the mean is 3.77, but the must-fix makes the verdict revise.
